text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Living up to her title as the "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf gloriously claimed her place on the Twinkle Series throne.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as the seasons turn...
A fresh breeze blows through Tracen Academy once more.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Freshwoman
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm lost...
And on my very first day of school~!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Freshwoman
text_block_list.text:
This academy is way too big~.
Ugh, what am I gonna do...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Are you having trouble?
I'm here to listen.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Freshwoman
text_block_list.text:
Yes... wait, huh?!
P-President Symboli Rudolf...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, you already knew about that?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Freshwoman
text_block_list.text: "B-Because watching your races made me want to come to this academy...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Is that so?
Those are the most delightful words I could hear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, if you require a guide, the most suitable person for the job stands right before your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you're fine with it, I'll lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Freshwoman
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
A-Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Now then—once again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Welcome to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We have been waiting for you.
—Let us chase our dream and seize it together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Everything you need for that is right here. Make the most of it, grow, and then..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I look forward to the day
you reach my throne.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Rudolf hasn't shown up.
I arrived at the student council room on time, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting!
choice_data_list: It's unusual for you to be late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I ran into a lost freshman along the way.
I was just showing them around campus for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She was brimming with hope and shining so brightly.
It was truly inspiring to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... whether she can hold onto that
hope depends on what she does from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The racing world is a meritocracy.
Those without strength are swiftly cast aside.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yet even so... I want to believe that each person's brilliance will never yield to despair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe that anyone can see
the clear blue sky beyond the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I too shall continue striving
to be worthy of the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Until they grasp the happiness they believe in,
I will guide everyone—every single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Will I be able to accomplish it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Your affirmation makes me—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An itinerary (koutei) to affirm (koutei) the "Emperor" (koutei)!
Yes, a wonderful pun has just been born.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*
Judging by your face, it was a dud.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must continue to charge myself with the mission
of winning you over with my puns.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, our ideals are still far off, and our work is too numerous to count.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "There will be no rest ahead. Even so, will you――"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You will continue to stand by my side,
won't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us take our steps even further from here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone chases our trail of light,
and none shall ever catch up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: For our glory awaits us upon a distant summit!
